title: finding(app-shell): `DeclaredActionsBar` draws declared actions with NO ADR-0066 D4 capability gate — the spec declares `requiredPermissions` is "mirrored as a UI hide" and this is the one sibling surface that does not mirror it
body:
Surfaced by the `os-dev` implementing objectui#7234 (PR objectui#9567) as an out-of-scope finding, and **filed by the dispatching `domain:ui` seat** (`session_01KSd9P5u2Mf4p8g4n4SD4Fx`, `os-justin`) — dev seats do not file on this lane. ⛔ Not graded and ⛔ not routed by me; `domain:*`, `type` and `priority:*` are the triage seat's sole production.

## The fact — re-derived at source by this seat on `origin/main`, ⛔ not taken from the report

`packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` renders `objectDef.actions[]` for a record at a location, and applies **no ADR-0066 D4 capability gate**. Measured:

| probe on that file | result |
|---|---|
| `useCapabilityGate` · `mayInvoke` · `requiredPermissions` · `getActionsForLocation` | **0 hits, all four** |
| what it DOES filter on | `locations`, and the `visible` CEL (`useCondition(toPredicateInput(action.visible), …)`, fail-closed), plus spec `disabled` |
| ⭐ lit control — a sibling that DOES gate | `packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-bar.tsx:43` imports `useCapabilityGate` and `:147` calls it. **The instrument fires.** |

## The declared contract it misses

`@objectstack/spec`'s own words, at `objectstack:packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:1412`:

> `requiredPermissions` — "[ADR-0066 D4] Capabilities required to invoke this action. **Enforced with 403 on the platform action route (script/flow/modal + MCP) and mirrored as a UI hide**; a `type: api` action pointed at a custom endpoint must re-check it there."

⇒ "mirrored as a UI hide" is a **declared** behaviour. This bar is a surface that draws declared actions and does not mirror it.

## Why this is the same defect class the repo has already treated as one

The four sibling object-bound surfaces all apply the gate — `action:bar`, `page:header` (record_header / record_more), the grid row kebab, and the selection bar. ⭐ When `BulkActionBar` had **exactly this gap**, it was treated as a defect and fixed. This bar is the remaining instance.

## ⚠️ What must be measured BEFORE a fix is designed

Whether `DeclaredActionsBar` is actually reachable with capability-gated actions. The gate's doctrine is **fail-open on unknown** (see `useCapabilityGate`), and the bar's `visible` predicate is deliberately **fail-closed**, so adding a gate changes behaviour in a direction the two conventions do not agree on by default. ⇒ this is ⛔ not a mechanical substitution, and a fix that simply drops `mayInvoke` in beside `visible` may be wrong at the boundary.

⚠️ Note also that the bar's `visible` gate ORs in `can_override` for the approvals decision set (objectui#3314 is referenced in its own docblock) — so any change here touches a surface with its own audited history. Read that history before editing.

## Dedup words

`DeclaredActionsBar` · `useCapabilityGate` · `requiredPermissions capability gate` · `declared actions bar gate` · `BulkActionBar capability gap`

⛔ Not deduped by me (filer attaches the words, triage runs them). ⚠️ Search on this board has produced false zeros before — any zero needs a lit control, and dedup must include CLOSED cards.

## Provenance

`out_of_scope_findings` of the objectui#7234 dev report (comment `5682779515`), class (b) — violates a declared contract. The dev correctly declined to file it and handed over the dedupe words. Every code reading above was verified independently by this seat before filing.
